title: Second and third query correlation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. Choose independently at each coordinate a sign triple by selecting $(U,V,-V)$ with probability $\delta$ and $(U,V,-UV)$ otherwise, with independent uniform signs $U,V$. The expectation of the product of $f$ on the second and third query vectors equals the noise stability of $f$ at correlation $-\delta$.
